automated.command: node --test structural-concept.test.mjs navigation.test.mjs wall-sections.test.mjs furnishings.test.mjs lamp-controls.test.mjs door-presentation.test.mjs site.test.mjs validate-deployment.test.mjs
focusedChecks: Actual default marker bounds remain clear of every exported door/window/OPEN aperture.
Native slab vertices are reused in the correct units and coordinate mapping; input export is not mutated.
Amber monitor endpoints use actual corner bottoms; hall question spans the original full 16-ft opening.
All diagram/reference bounds translate coherently when the shared datum changes.
Missing native references and nonpositive marker dimensions fail explicitly; geometry remains finite and lightweight.

desktopChecksPassed: Concept isolates architecture/site/approach/furniture and shows visible non-engineered warning.
Wall context and roof-envelope toggles control separate reference objects only.
Hidden structure controls transfer keyboard focus to the selected normal mode.
Cutaway restores original architecture and saved furniture preference.
Hidden lamp lights disable without losing saved individual switch state.
Interior starts in a collision-clear entrance position; Fly returns to safe walking.
Plan remains the approved separate architectural plan.
Five-mode arrow-key radio navigation leaves exactly one checked/tabbable mode.
responsiveAssertions: All visible buttons at least 44 x 44 CSS px
browser.responsiveAdjustment: Compacted Structure warning and omitted duplicate datum line on short landscape screens; 667 x 375 Structure render height improved from 115 to 137 CSS px.
browser.deviceLimit: Real browser responsive viewports, not a physical low-end-phone GPU or FPS benchmark.

images.structure-overview.png: Live desktop diagram with roof envelope; warning added to saved render.
images.structure-context.png: Same desktop camera with exact native wall/opening context; warning retained.
images.structure-open-span.png: Closer hall/monitor support-question detail with roof envelope off; not a whole-building fit.
images.structure-mobile-render.png: Live render at a 390 x 844 responsive viewport, with review warning; not a full-page UI screenshot.

limits: Twelve perimeter study markers and their 0.30-ft graphic widths are not a structural column layout/count or member sizes.
Dashed beam axes have no physical section; roof/slab/wall outlines are architectural references only.
No verified roof/monitor transfer, internal gravity support, lateral system, slab adequacy, joint design, foundation, soil or loading design.
No reinforcement, safe spans, structural quantities or construction approval.
New structural feature remains local/unmerged/unpushed pending separate authorization.
